comparison.objective: Extract a locked terminal; record holds an LED flush while contacting its pad with an iron.
comparison.physical_skill: Blade insertion beneath a tab and coupled withdrawal versus sustained bimanual support and precise tool-tip contact near hazards.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal removal without damage or unintended release versus two-second pad contact with the LED flush, followed by safe iron stowage. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Shared precision and bimanual coordination do not make lock release equivalent to soldering contact control.
